responses.reason: The current contract already documents this ambiguity in the global uncertain entry, including both plausible candidates: updating prev_in during reset versus clearing/suppressing it during reset. No field change is needed.
responses.spec_quote: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
